notes.title: Summer sale last day! + Patch update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34576833/3da5b020e50323c286f14ffd57ef5ff5978154bc.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone!

Only few more hours before the summer sale ends!

[h1]40% Off ![/h1] Make sure to grab 93845617 copies! 
It'll definitely help me make the next episode..

[h1]-[/h1]

So regarding the last update: 
Few have kindly reported about having an issue with steam achievements, for that I apologize the update should fix the issue (hopefully..)
As for the update size (200 MB), It should've been a couple of KBs but it's due to updating the game engine version which should improve on performance.


  
[h1]PS[/h1]
Thanks to everyone who supported the game with a purchase, a compliment or a comment (positive and negative) I appreciate it.
[spoiler]If you left a negative non-constructive criticism I hope your left mouse click button doesn't work for a solid 8 minutes straight..[/spoiler]
	
Thanks again!
